header.running_head: The Sahabah (RA) See Rasulullaah ﷺ in their Dreams

blocks.text: Ali. Turn around.' When I turned around, I saw two men[^1] bound in fetters, whose heads were being crushed by boulders. Each time, their heads were crushed, they were then restored, after which the process continued.'

The following day, I was proceeding on my way to meet Hadhrat Ali (RA) as I did every day, but as I was passing by the place where butchers gathered, I met some people who informed me that the Ameerul Mu'mineen had been assassinated."[^2]
Hadhrat Hasan bin Ali (RA) sees Nabi ﷺ in a Dream

Hadhrat Filfila Ju'fi reports that he heard Hadhrat Hasan bin Ali (RA) say, "I saw in a dream that Nabi ﷺ was holding on to the Arsh. I then saw that Abu Bakr (RA) was holding on to Nabi ﷺ's waist, that Umar (RA) was holding on to Abu Bakr (RA)'s waist and that Uthmaan (RA) was holding on to Umar (RA)'s waist. Then I saw blood extending from the sky to the earth." When Hadhrat Hasan (RA) was relating this dream, there happened to be some members of the Shia sect with him, who then asked, "Did you not see Ali (RA)?" Hadhrat Hasan (RA) replied, "There is none I would not have loved to see holding Nabi ﷺ's waist more than Ali (RA). Nevertheless, that was the dream that I saw..." The narration continued further.[^3]

Hadhrat Hasan (RA) once said, "O people! I saw a most remarkable thing in my dream last night. I saw the Rabb the Most High upon the Arsh. Rasulullaah ﷺ then arrived and stood by one of the feet of the Arsh. Thereafter, Abu Bakr (RA) arrived and placed his hand upon Rasulullaah ﷺ's shoulder. He was followed by Umar (RA), who placed his hand upon Abu Bakr (RA)'s shoulder, after which Uthmaan (RA) arrived and placed his hand upon Hadhrat Umar (RA)'s shoulder. Uthmaan (RA) then gestured with his hand and said, 'O my Rabb! Ask Your servants why they killed me.' Two downpipes of blood then started to flow from the sky to the earth."
Someone reported this to Hadhrat Ali (RA), saying, "Do you not see what (your son) Hasan (RA) is saying?" Hadhrat Ali (RA)'s reply was, "He is only relating what he saw."

Another narration states that Hadhrat Hasan (RA) added, "I shall not fight again after the dream that I saw..." The narration then proceeds like the one above, but with the difference that he said, "I then saw Uthmaan (RA) with his hand upon Umar (RA)'s shoulder. Thereafter, I saw a lot of blood behind them. 'What is this?' I enquired. I was then informed that this was the blood of Uthmaan (RA), for which he was asking redress from Allaah."[^4]
These two were probably Hadhrat Ali (RA)'s assassin Ibn Muljim and his accomplice.
Abu Ya'la, as quoted in Muntakhab Kanzul Ummaal (Vol.5 Pg.61).
Tabraani in his Awsat and Kabeer, reporting from reliable sources as confirmed by Haythami (Vol.9 Pg.96).
Abu Ya'la. Haythami (Vol.9 Pg.96) has commented on the chain of narrators.
